page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Latin with Hebrew headwords and quotations, running from top to bottom. Printed page number top right. Running head top centre in Hebrew. No marginal notes. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: רִבּוֹא f. Myrias, multitudo decem millium, Neh.7.66. Et absq; א רִבּוֹ Jona 4.11. Dual. רִבּוֹתַיִם Dua myriades Psal.68.18. Plural. רִבֹּאוֹת Multæ myriades, Dan.11.12. Et absque א רִבּוֹת Neh.7.71. Chald. singul. & Plural. וּרְבוֹ רִבְּוָן Et myrias myriadum, Dan.7.10. Dagelsch[?] ex plurali ejecto, & juxta Masorethas legendum רִבְּוָן, quasi à sing. רִבְּוָא.
רִבָּבָה f. Idem, Lev.26.8. Plur. רִבָּבוֹת Myriades, 1.Sam. 18.8. Constr. רִבְּבוֹת אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל Ad myriadas millium Israëlis, Num.10.36.
רְבִיבִים m.p. Imbres, Guttæ imbris, à Magnitudine, Jer.3.3. וּכְרְבִיבִים עַלי־עֵשֶׂב Et sicut imbres super adultam herbam, Deut.32.2.
רָבַךְ Adorhavit, Instruxit, Instravit: Præterit. מֵרְבְּדִים רִבַּדְתִּי עַרְשִׂי Cadurcis instruxi spondam[?] meam, Prov.7.16.
רָבִיד m. Torques, Ezech.16.11. Constr. רִבִד הַזָּהָב Torquem aurcum[?] in collo tuo, Gen.41.42.
מַרְבְּדִים m.p. Cadurca, Tapetes lectorum, Lectister-nia ornatoria, Prov.7.16. & 31.22.

רָבָה Multum esse, Multiplicari, Augeri, Augescere, Crescere, Magnum esse: Item, Jaculari: Præterit. וָחַיִּת וְרָבִיתָ Vivas & multiplices, Deut.30.16. וְרָבוּ כְמוֹ רָבוּ Et multiplicabuntur sicut multiplicati sunt, Zach.10.8. Partic. רֹבָה Jaculans, Jaculator, Gen.21.20. Imper. פְּרֵה וּרְבֵה Cresce & multiplicare, Gen.35.11. Fut. per Apocopam, יִרַב Augescat, Multiplicetur, Gen.1.22. Et aliter, וַיִּרֶב Et major erat, 1.Reg.4.v.30. Chald. Præt. רְבָה אִילָנָה Crevit arbor, Dan.4.8. די רְבִית Qui crevisti, v.19. ubi Masorethæ notant, abundare: Literæ tamen repræsentant formam quæ legitur Dan.2.31.41. & alibi: Fœm. רְבַת[?]

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the small type are hard to read at this scan resolution and are given as best read; the Hebrew forms should be checked against a clearer copy. Doubtful Latin readings marked [?]: "Dagelsch" (possibly Dagesch), "spondam" (long s in the printed word unclear), "aurcum" (possibly aureum as printed). Last Hebrew word of the final entry is cut off at the lower right and is uncertain. Printed Gen.41.42 and Prov.31.22 kept as printed. Catchword "Crevit," kept only in bottom_margin.
